integrity_note: The proof and supporting program concern the same exact two-parameter theorem. Numerical tests corroborate but do not substitute for its universal proof; no independent validation has been performed. Source dates refer to first public preprint versions, not later revisions or journals.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge shortest-path distances on two cliques linked by exactly one bridge; the exponent classification does not cover arbitrary edge weights, longer bridges, extra cross-edges or full post-threshold inertia.
title: Sharp generalized roundness of bridged complete-graph metrics
